title: Complementary components of a reduced pure subcurve
statement: Let $X$ be a reduced Noetherian scheme [def-pc-reduced-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth], where Noetherian means locally Noetherian and quasi-compact (every open cover has a finite subcover). Suppose every irreducible component of $X$ [def-weil-irreducible-components] has topological Krull dimension $1$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let $Y\subseteq X$ be a reduced closed subscheme [def-weil-closed-immersion] all of whose irreducible components have dimension $1$. Let $Z\subseteq X$ be the reduced induced closed subscheme on $\overline{|X|\setminus|Y|}$ [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme]. There is a subset $I$ of the finite set of irreducible components of $X$ such that $Y$ is the reduced closed union of the components in $I$ and $Z$ is the reduced closed union of all remaining components. Every irreducible component of $Z$ has dimension $1$, and the reduced induced closed subscheme on $\overline{|X|\setminus|Z|}$ is $Y$. Empty $Y$ and empty $Z$ are allowed; the component dimension condition for the empty scheme is vacuous.

source.place: Tag 0E38 (lemma-closed-subscheme-nodal-curve), first paragraph of the proof: reduced equidimensional one-dimensional closed subschemes are unions of components; the complementary-union and double-complement consequences require no nodal hypothesis.
